name: ancient-survey candidates (public, coarse)
note: Each feature is a 0.05° (~5 km) grid cell containing at least one candidate that passed agent review. No exact positions are published, to protect possible sites from looting. Candidates are unverified desk results, not discoveries. EMPTY: no survey candidate has passed a real (model-backed) review yet. Runs without a model use offline rule stand-ins, whose passes are never published.
